anh_en: When the Concerto Effect is triggered, if the attribute types of the two Characters are both <color=#1891e7>Glacio</color>, the <color=#8c7e51>Glacio Concerto</color> is triggered, causing <color=#1891e7>Glacio</color> DMG to the target.

Triggers <color=#8c7e51>Hot and Cold Ensemble</color> when Concerto Effect is triggered if both Character's Attribute Types are <color=#1891e7>Glacio</color> and <color=#e15226>Fusion</color>, respectively.\nDamage dealt by the debuting CharacterResonance Liberation is increased by <color=#8c7e51>40%</color> for <color=#8c7e51>12</color> seconds. does not take effect when the Character is not debuting.

When the Concerto Effect is triggered, if both Characters have the same attribute type of <color=#e15226>Fusion</color>, it triggers the <color=#8c7e51>Fusion flurry</color>, which inflicts <color=#e15226>Fusion</color> DMG.

When the Concerto Effect is triggered, if both Character's attribute types are <color=#1891e7>Glacio</color> and <color=#9656d8>Electro</color>, it triggers the <color=#8c7e51>Cold and Electric Ensemble</color>.\nDebuting CharacterBasic Attack and Heavy Attack deal <color=#8c7e51>40% more damage</color> for <color=#8c7e51>12</color> seconds. does not take effect when the Character is not debuting.

Triggers <color=#8c7e51>Thermoelectric Ensemble</color> when Concerto Effect is triggered if both Character's Attribute Types are <color=#e15226>Fusion</color> and <color=#9656d8>Electro</color>, respectively.\nDamage dealt by the debuting CharacterResonance Skill is increased by <color=#8c7e51>40%</color> for <color=#8c7e51>12</color> seconds.The effect does not take effect when the Character is not debuting.

When the Concerto Effect is triggered, if both Characters have the same attribute type of <color=#9656d8>Electro</color>, it triggers the <color=#8c7e51>Electro flurry</color>, which deals <color=#9656d8> Electro</color> damage.

Triggers <color=#8c7e51>Air Cold Ensemble</color> if both Character's Attribute Types are <color=#46c3d4>Aero</color> and <color=#1891e7>Glacio</color>, respectively, when triggering Concerto Effect.\nDamage dealt by the boarding CharacterResonance Skill is increased by <color=#8c7e51>40%</color> for <color=#8c7e51>12</color> seconds. does not take effect when the Character is not boarded.

When the Concerto Effect is triggered, if both Character's Attribute Types are <color=#46c3d4>Aero</color> and <color=#e15226>Fusion</color> respectively, it triggers the <color=#8c7e51> Aerothermal Ensemble</color>.\nThe damage dealt by the debuting CharacterBasic Attack and Heavy Attack is increased by <color=#8c7e51>40%</color> for <color=#8c7e51>12</color> seconds. does not take effect when the Character is not debuting.

Triggers <color=#8c7e51>Electro Ensemble</color> when Concerto Effect is triggered if both Character's Attribute Types are <color=#9656d8>Electro</color> and <color=#46c3d4>Aero</color>, respectively.\nDamage dealt by the boarding CharacterResonance Liberation is increased by <color=#8c7e51>40%</color> for <color=#8c7e51>12</color> seconds. does not take effect when the Character is not boarded.

When the Concerto Effect is triggered, if both Characters have the same attribute type of <color=#46c3d4>Aero</color>, it triggers the <color=#8c7e51>Aero flurry</color>, which inflicts <color=#46c3d4>Aero</color> on the target Damage.

When the Concerto Effect is triggered, if the attribute types of the two Characters are <color=#1891e7>Glacio</color> and <color=#d4bf5f>Spectro</color> respectively, the <color=#8c7e51>Glacio extension</color>.\nProduces a short, wide-area stasis effect and the debuting Character gains <color=#8c7e51>10</color> points of Resonance Energy.

When the Concerto Effect is triggered, if the attribute types of the two Characters are <color=#e15226>Fusion</color> and <color=#d4bf5f>Spectro</color> respectively, then the <color=#8c7e51>Fusion extension</color>.\nProduces a short, wide-area stasis effect and the debuting Character gains <color=#8c7e51>10</color> points of Resonance Energy.

When the Concerto Effect is triggered, if the attribute types of the two Characters are <color=#9656d8>Electro</color> and <color=#d4bf5f>Spectro</color> respectively, the <color=#8c7e51>Electro extension</color>.\nProduces a short, wide-area stasis effect and the debuting Character gains <color=#8c7e51>10</color> points of Resonance Energy.

When the Concerto Effect is triggered, the <color=#8c7e51>Aero Delay</color> is triggered if the two Character's attribute types are <color=#46c3d4>Aero</color> and <color=#d4bf5f>Spectro</color>, respectively.\nProduces a short, wide-area stasis effect and the debuting Character gains <color=#8c7e51>10</color> points of Resonance Energy.

When Concerto Effect is triggered, if both Characters have the same attribute type of <color=#d4bf5f>Spectro</color>, it triggers the <color=#8c7e51>Spectro flurry</color>, which deals <color=#d4bf5f> Spectro</color> damage.

When the Concerto Effect is triggered, if the attribute types of the two Resonators are <color=#1891e7>Glacio</color> and <color=#7e1f57>Havoc</color> respectively, then the <color=#8c7e51>Glacio Continuum</color>.\nDamage dealt by the incoming Resonator's Resonance Skill is increased by <color=#8c7e51>20%</color> for <color=#8c7e51>15</color> seconds. The effect does not wear off while the Resonator's switched off, and the damage dealt by Resonance Skill is increased by an additional <color=#8c7e51>20%</color>.

When the Concerto Effect is triggered, if the attribute types of the two Resonators are <color=#e15226>Fusion</color> and <color=#7e1f57>Havoc</color> respectively, then the <color=#8c7e51>Fusion Continuum</color>.\nDamage dealt by the incoming Resonator's Resonance Skill is increased by <color=#8c7e51>20%</color> for <color=#8c7e51>15</color> seconds. The effect does not wear off while in the resonator's swithed, and the damage dealt by Resonance Skill is increased by an additional <color=#8c7e51>20%</color>.

When the Concerto Effect is triggered, if the attribute types of the two Characters are <color=#9656d8>Electro</color> and <color=#7e1f57>Havoc</color> respectively, then the <color=#8c7e51>Electro continuum</color>.\nDamage dealt by the incoming Resonator's Resonance Skill is increased by <color=#8c7e51>20%</color> for <color=#8c7e51>15</color> seconds. The effect does not wear off while in an unregistered state, and the damage dealt by Resonance Skill is increased by an additional <color=#8c7e51>20%</color>.

When the Concerto Effect is triggered, the <color=#8c7e51>Aero Consonance</color> is triggered if both Character's Attribute Types are <color=#46c3d4>Aero</color> and <color=#7e1f57>Havoc</color>, respectively.\nThe damage dealt by the debut CharacterResonance Skill is increased by <color=#8c7e51>20%</color> for <color=#8c7e51>15</color> seconds. The effect does not wear off while in an unregistered state, and the damage dealt by Resonance Skill is increased by an additional <color=#8c7e51>20%</color>.

When the Concerto Effect is triggered, if the attribute types of the two Characters are <color=#d4bf5f>Spectro</color> and <color=#7e1f57>Havoc</color>, it triggers the <color=#8c7e51>Diphase Replay</color>.\nAttribute damage dealt by the entire team is increased by <color=#8c7e51>20%</color> for <color=#8c7e51>12</color> seconds.

When the Concerto Effect is triggered, if both Characters have the same attribute type of <color=#7e1f57>Havoc</color>, it triggers <color=#8c7e51>Havoc Flurry</color>, which deals <color=#7e1f57>Havoc</ color> damage.

An institution that operates independently of the administrative, judicial, and military branches of Huanglong, with the highest official titled "Chief Commander." Reporting directly to the Emperor of Huanglong, it holds the authority to investigate any case, official, or criminal without approval from other agencies, with the power to "act first, report later." Tasked with handling intricate cases year-round, the agency has developed specialized expertise in managing Resonators.

A special agency responsible for monitoring Sentinels, astronomy, and calendars across Huanglong's various cities. Led by the Minister of Sentinel Affairs in Mingting, it has subordinate bureaus in the other six cities, each headed by an Intendant. While they hold independent authority on Sentinel-related matters, they are limited to advising and supervising the administrative bodies of each city and Mingting.

A unique Resonance Ability of Qiuyuan. By perceiving the nature and differences of surrounding frequencies, he can discern an enemy's location and even state of mind. In extreme cases, this perception can be amplified through Sonoro Spheres, bringing to life the mental imagery of his enemies—or even his own.

A civilization located at the polar region of Solaris. Ancient shifts in the planetary axis redefined the world's geography, turning the Lahai-Roi region into what is now the planet's pole. Over time, the vast caverns deep beneath thick layers of ice and snow gradually became habitable for humankind. In this warm and humid underground haven stands an academic metropolis for Resonators, celebrated as the "Research Haven of Solaris" and a "Utopia for Researchers."

A Tidespawn created by Leviathan. It is a fusion of the frequencies of three powerful Tacet Discords: the great lion "Nemea," the ancestral goat "Pan," and the slippery serpent "Python." Once Leviathan's "first offspring," it now "resides" within Galbrena after merging with her frequency.\nWithin this fused being, the lion's brutal nature dominates Chimera's will, while the goat tempers its violence by feeding on human compassion. The serpent, sly and independent, appears loyal to Galbrena but secretly undermines her frequency.
The past name of "Murmurstown." Devastated sixteen years ago by the outbreak of the Dark Tide, it is now a lost Gladiator town in the Wastelands.

The Tacet Fields that exist in isolated dimensions. \n"Tacet Fields" are thought to be where all Tacet Discords originate. These locations feature a sky of inverted seas and a deep cross-shaped Tacet Mark on the ground. Reverberations fill the air, linking our world to an unknown space through a white Resonance Cord. These areas attract gatherings of Tacet Discords.

As the highest official in Huanglong's Ministry of War, the Minister oversees all military affairs for the six cities in Huanglong. The honorific title "Grand Marshal" is used to signify the rank and authority of this position.
The capital of Huanglong. The nation's political, economic, and cultural center.

The Ministry of War is Huanglong's supreme military command, headquartered in Mingting with branches in all six cities. Its leader, the Minister of War, holds supreme command over all military affairs. Authority is delegated to a General in each city, who manages local forces. While Mingting usually appoints these Generals, local Sentinels have the authority to do so in certain special cities.

One of Huanglong's three judicial bodies. It holds the authority to jointly try major cases and wields significant supervisory power, a duty summarized as "to probe evil and maintain discipline." Its officials are generally titled Censors, while those stationed or assigned temporarily in the six cities are called Investigating Censors.

Just as the name enjoyed by Napoli the Second, it is a title Primus Fenrico should have rightfully possessed. However, due to unknown reasons, Fenrico forbade Acolytes from referring to him as such, until he met his end at the bottom of the sea. In the history of the Order of the Deep, he is the only one who bears the name "Fenrico."
A region located between Mengzhou and Jinzhou. It is considered a vital passage way between the two cities, and also once a strategic hold for intercepting Tacet Discords.

An amalgamated horror that often emerges alongside Void Storms. During lulls between Storms, it primarily inhabits the highly concentrated Voidmatter environment of the Mawburrow Desert. The Voidmatter Regulators on its head serve as both its power source and its weakness.

Officially the "Resonator Nursing Unit," the infirmary is a clinical-research hybrid facility overseen by Rabelle College.\nManaged by Academy physician Luuk Herssen, it utilizes Frequency Therapeutics to provide comprehensive healthcare for the students and faculty of Startorch Academy.

An identity authentication device issued by the Spacetrek Collective, serving as mandatory safety gear for navigating Lahai-Roi.\nAll first-year students must complete the Cassette's burning and registration under faculty supervision at the Research Institute before venturing beyond the Academy's protected zones.

A standardized Terminal for the Spacetrek Collective members, designed to hold the Rabelle Cassette.\nIts casing is constructed from a special composite that mimics the Exostrider's engineering, granting partial resistance to Void Storms.

A colossal mech of alien origin, now dormant in the Roya Frostlands. Startorch Academy was founded to train Synchronists capable of establishing Augmented Resonance with it.\nIn the Roya's Trine Myth, it is revered as Baldur, the earthly incarnation of the sun deity Sol. Legend claims it once held up the earth's collapsing crust with its greatsword, saving the Roya from annihilation. Predictions foretell it will awaken from its slumber to confront the ruinous Hvedrungr in a final, apocalyptic battle.

Candidates selected from across Solaris who can link their consciousness to the giant Exostrider mech via an external mechanical interface.\nThese Synchronists can achieve a degree of control over the Exostrider through Augmented Resonance. To identify and train these rare pilots, Startorch Academy established Rabelle College.

The Exostrider's power core and Lahai-Roi's underground "sun."\nRoyan records say this energy entity was removed from the Exostrider and placed underground to sustain the haven. However, monitoring data confirms a gradual but steady decline in its energy output. Both the Roya and the Spacetrek Collective are now formulating emergency contingencies in response.

A colossal vertical transport system built along the Exostrider's greatsword, connecting Lahai-Roi and the Roya Frostlands.\nIts structure resembles a spine piercing both heaven and earth. Powered by orbital-acceleration technology, it connects the deep cavern to the surface and serves as Lahai-Roi's most important transportation hubs.

The Exostrider's remaining weapon. The blade is buried deep within Sundermere, while its hilt supports the very ceiling of the cavern, forming a structural pillar through the heart of Lahai-Roi.\nIn the Roya's Trine Myth, it is predicted that Baldur will draw this sword in the final battle against the ruinous entity Hvedrungr.

A monitoring instrument installed on the surface of Sundermere by the Spacetrek Collective to oversee and maintain the Reactor Drive.\nAt its core is a replica of the Exostrider's calibration module, enabling a dedicated data link with the Drive to transmit real-time correction parameters. Hyvatia plays a vital role in ensuring the Reactor Drive's continuous and stable operation.

Specialized protective infrastructure developed by Startorch Academy, using reverse-engineered materials inspired by the Exostrider's surface fibers and coatings. It provides a degree of resistance against Voidmatter contamination.\nIt is now deployed as a standard protective measure in Spacetrek Collective camps, research outposts, and transit hubs. The largest installation is the Antivoid Canopy surrounding Startorch Academy.

The indigenous inhabitants of Lahai-Roi. They have lived in the underground cavern long before the Spacetrek Collective's arrival. They now maintain a cooperative relationship with it.\nBy observing the Reactor Drive's operational cycles, the Roya devised their own calendar. They guide the growth and migration of the Exoswarm, a sacred duty they regard as their tribe's calling.

A Spacetrek Collective project decades in the making to replace the Reactor Drive in the sky with Helios, an artificial sun engineered by the Research Institute.\nIts ultimate goal is to retrieve the Drive as a power source to awaken the Exostrider slumbering in the frostlands, all while keeping Lahai-Roi's ecosystem stable.

The artificial sun crafted by the Spacetrek Collective: Research Institute to replace the Reactor Drive in the New Solar Ceremony.\nFor successful operation, it requires environmental data from Hyvatia and raw observational data on the Reactor Drive provided by the Heliogyre.

The sacred ground of the Roya and the dwelling of the Heliodic Six. It safeguards Exostrider parts and serves as the central archive for all Royan records.\nWith each operational cycle of the Reactor Drive, the Solisylum calculates its stability, tracks the birth and growth of the Exoswarm, and monitors their eventual return to the Exostrider.
An artifact used exclusively by the Heliodic Six to observe the Reactor Drive.\nDuring the New Solar Ceremony, it provides Helios with raw observational data on the Reactor Drive.

Roya elders such as the Eye, the Binder, and the Shaper. Each pair in the Six is entrusted with the roles of observation, archival, and extrapolation.\nThey reside within the Solisylum, tracing the Reactor Drive's trajectories and forecasting Void Storms.
The forest where the Soliskin dwell. Bathed in the light of the Reactor Drive, the woods remain untouched by the ravages of Void Storms.
Biomechanical creatures formed from the Exostrider's cellular remnants. By mimicking herds and other lifeforms, they helped rebuild Lahai-Roi's ecosystem.
Materials harvested from Exoswarm. Though still essentially parts of the Exostrider, they are widely utilized in engineering Lahai-Roi's various constructs.

Roya chosen by the Soliskin for their pure nature become Shepherds. Their duty is to guide and care for the Soliskin. They lead the Soliskin to the best sunlit areas of Bjartr Woods and keep them safe.

Individuals gifted in calendrical calculation and a degree of resonance with the Exostrider and Soliskin are permitted into the Solisylum. There, they serve the Heliodic Six as aides and the tribe as healers and teachers, all while being groomed as the Six's eventual successors.
A type of Exoswarm originating from the Exostrider's neural structures. They are believed to embody fragments of its consciousness.
Towering constructs widespread in Bjartr Woods, forming a vast, floating forest. Their roots permeate Lahai-Roi, relaying information directly to the Heliogyre.

A ceremony held by the Roya for the Soliskin. During the rite, the Soliskin transform into ethereal energy forms. Guided by Shepherds, they enter the Solistrees and disperse into luminescence as they rise.\nThe Roya believe this marks the Soliskin's return to the Exostrider.

A Waveworn Phenomenon unique to Lahai-Roi, erupting when Voidmatter concentrations reach a critical threshold. It indiscriminately dissolves all matter and existence within its range, causing widespread devastation. Before it strikes, an atmospheric light known as the Shimmer typically appears, serving as an early warning.

A warm, humid underground haven deep beneath the Roya Frostlands. Following an ancient polar shift that made Lahai-Roi Solaris's new pole, the changing climate drove the surface-dwelling Roya to migrate below. Long isolated, it became a refuge for extinct prehistoric life, which has since evolved into a unique and remarkably independent ecosystem.

Officially titled the Spacetrek Collective: Startorch Academy, this borderless academic metropolis trains Synchronists and spearheads research into the giant mech known as the Exostrider. Its name embodies its core ethos: "to carry the flame of inquiry and ignite the torch of civilization." Here, seekers of knowledge from across the world gather, knowledge flows freely, and cultures meet in harmony.

An operation conducted by Septimont's Gladiators to eliminate the Dark Tide and its creations within the Sanguis Plateaus.\nThe Plateaus' unique terrain allows Remnant Energy to accumulate, sustaining the lingering Blightcloud hanging over the area, a remnant of the first Dark Tide outbreak in Rinascita. Consequently, the region has become a breeding ground for Dark Tide creatures, where the Dark Tide's corruption continues to spread unchecked.\nAs the confrontation with the Dark Tide stretched on, the Septimontians discovered a strategy to effectively curb the Dark Tide's advance: luring its creations toward the Earthrend Wedge and hunting them near its base. Since then, the "hunt" gradually evolved into an institutionalized tradition deeply woven into Septimont's culture.
A type of Tacet Discord born from the Dark Tide.

A colossal wedge-shaped structure located in the lower levels of the Sanguis Plateaus. It descended from the high heavens alongside Rinascita's Sentinel Imperator, who had full control over it. When the first Dark Tide outbreak struck Rinascita, the Earthrend Wedge was activated. Its energy field effectively suppressed the Blightcloud above the hunting grounds, preventing it from spreading into Septimont's urban areas. Subsequently, the Dark Tide stemming from the clouds has been mostly contained within the lower levels of the Plateaus.
Located on the outskirts of the city of Septimont, it's the "air terminal" where Gladiators cross the canyons and make their trip to and from the Sanguis Plateaus.
The living quarters of Priestesses, where fate is observed and prophecies are documented. Commonly referred to as the "Temple."
The main hunting ground on the mid to upper levels of the Sanguis Plateaus, where generations of Septimontians battled the Dark Tide and its creations.
A Common Echo in the form of a large horn. Hornett's high-pitched and lengthy blare is used to signal the beginning or the conclusion of large-scale hunting operations.
The mainland of Septimont and the Sanguis Plateaus are separated by a narrow and long waterway.

A unique flame produced by igniting specific minerals. Its appearance resembles sunlight more than ordinary fire. The precise types and proportions of minerals used to create this flame are a closely guarded secret, passed down exclusively through generations of Priestesses.\nWhile the Sacred Flame offers no special power, Priestesses channel their Resonance power through it, using its light to glimpse the future and deliver prophecies.\nYet to the Priestesses, the Sacred Flame is more than just a medium for divination. They view it as "celestial light descended to the mortal world," often referring to it as "the flames."

The ruins of a bygone civilization, said to be hidden deep beneath the Sanguis Plateaus. Its entrance is located in the Wastelands. Long ago, it was visited by the three Heroes of Heroes from Septimont.\nLegend has it that those who manage to set foot in Manes Deep can hear the whispers of the Heroes of Heroes and thereby gain powers rivaling their own. Some also hold that since the Heroes of Heroes walked this place, the journey to Manes Deep has become an inescapable trial for any who would claim that title.

A medal bestowed by the rulers of Septimont exclusively to Gladiators who demonstrate exceptional performance in the hunt against the Dark Tide. It is regarded as one of the highest honors among Gladiators.

Native to the Septimont region, Griffrexes once coexisted with the ancestors of Septimont who sought refuge in Rinascita.\nHowever, the outbreak of the first Dark Tide devastated the Border Mountains, the Griffrexes' habitat, driving most of the species to extinction. Since then, Griffrexes exist mostly as Common Echoes, which are generated at a fixed frequency from Resonance Beacons.\nOver time, Septimontians became aware that these Griffrex Echoes still retained their instincts of hunting and sensing external frequencies. As a result, they were trained as Common Echoes for hunting purposes to track and attack Dark Tide creations.

A type of small device manufactured with Tacetite formed around the Earthrend Wedge. It provides energy to Anchor Obelisks, which in turn amplify its frequency to repel the Dark Tide and its creations.\nDuring the hunts, Gladiators of Septimont strategically set up Anchor Obelisks carrying Anchor Stones at critical locations across Maroonwood, the main battlefield. These devices help them drive the Dark Tide and its creations toward the base of the Earthrend Wedge, where they are eliminated. The strategy has proven highly effective in preventing the Dark Tide's spread beyond the Earthrend Wedge's containment.

An installation that can be field-deployed to amplify the frequency produced by Anchor Stones. Once the Anchor Stone is inserted, it can generate an energy field to repel the Dark Tide and its creations.\nDuring the hunts, Gladiators of Septimont strategically set up Anchor Obelisks carrying Anchor Stones at critical locations across Maroonwood, the main battlefield. These devices help them drive the Dark Tide and its creations toward the base of the Earthrend Wedge, where they are eliminated. The strategy has proven highly effective in preventing the Dark Tide's spread beyond the Earthrend Wedge's containment.

A field nestled deep within Maroonwood. At an elevation approaching Earthrend Wedge and situated in the lower middle level of the Sanguis Plateaus, it serves as the primary battleground where Gladiators engage in deadly combat with the Dark Tide and its creatures.
A lost Gladiator town located in the Wastelands at lower levels of the Sanguis Plateaus.
The term referring to the lower levels of the Sanguis Plateaus corrupted by the Dark Tide. This desolate region is marked by hostile conditions and is largely devoid of human activity.

A legendary plant said to grow in Manes Deep. It can survive for years in environments tainted by the Dark Tide, giving it a natural resistance to corruption. When used in medicine, it can slow the Dark Tide's corruption effect on the human body and help restore consciousness.

Victims of Dark Tide corruption who have lost all self-awareness. Their bodies usually resemble stone statues while retaining their original size. Such individuals constantly murmur and recite incomprehensible words and "hymns praising the Dark Tide." The voices from the Hollow Figures have been confirmed to be mentally debilitating, capable of influencing the cognition and mental stability of ordinary people to some extent.

Objects that look like giant stone statues. They are often found near heavily traveled routes or high vantage points, serving as navigational markers for passersby. Some argue that these Waystones are a special type of Echo, formed from the fervent emotional frequencies of Gladiators who traveled through these areas. This theory, however, remains controversial in academic circles.
This type includes Hologram Echo: Chest Mimic, Hologram Echo: Junrock, Hologram Echo: Drake, Hologram Echo: Hoartoise, and Hologram Echo: Puff.
This type includes Tacetite Spikes with Optional Module II, Glacio Beacon, Hologram Echo: Junrock with Optional Module I, Frost Spout, Hologram Echo: Puff, and Freeze Jet
This type includes: Tacetite Barrage with Optional Module I, Hologram Echo: Drake, Hologram Echo: Hoartoise with Optional Module II, Hologram Echo: Chest Mimic, and Burst Launcher
This type includes Repulsor Spout, Vortex Generator, Whirlpool Device.
This type includes Stun Emitter, Tacetite Spikes with Optional Module I, Thunder Lance, and Shock Inductor.
Nimbus Wraith and Tacet Discords defeated by Hologram Echo: Chest Mimic may drop this item.
KU-Money's Shop appears after certain waves, where you can consume Sim Credits to purchase Tactics and items.
A Tactic Set that generates Chain Lightnings bouncing between targets, which is triggered by inflicting Paralysis on the targets.
A Tactic Set that improves resource acquisition efficiency and converts surplus resources into offensive power.
A Tactic Set focused on fire suppression by boosting Attack Speed and Control effects.
The highly recommended core tactics of a Tactic Set.
This type of Tactic increases ATK, Crit. Rate, and DMG of certain Attributes, and reduces Tacet Discords' RES, improving the attack efficiency.
This type of Tactic enhances nearby Combat Machines within a certain range when active.
This type of Tactic enhances debuffs like Paralysis, Slow, Frozen, and Burning.

A planet-wide phenomenon born from an anomalous Lament event. It now blankets Solaris's sky. Research suggests it is composed of extremely high-density Remnant Energy. Since its appearance, all of Solaris's space exploration has been brought to a complete standstill.

The entry point formed when the Exostrider and the Threnodian Aleph-1 entered Solaris. Researchers in Lahai-Roi widely believe it leads to outer space. The overlying Soliskin root network holds Aleph-1's power at bay, the "sealed doors" of the Stridergate.

A phenomenon unique to the surface of the Roya Frostlands. Scholars theorize that this anomaly emerged when the Threnodian's power there attempted to devour the Exostrider, triggering abnormal Voidmatter transformations. Affected objects enter a state of unstable "existence," becoming impossible to observe directly.

A specialized device developed by the Spacetrek Collective for research operations in the Roya Frostlands. It forces entities with fluctuating Voidmatter levels back into the observable state for practical use. In areas with stable signal coverage, the device can be deployed directly to the user's location.

A Court of Savantae space station launched into near-Solaris orbit before the Etheric Sea fully enveloped the planet. Its primary mission was the study of Etheric Sea Droplets, research intended to pave the way for further space exploration.

A high-dimensional domain embedded deep within high-density Voidmatter, existing "inside" Aleph-1. The fundamental laws of time and space descend into total chaos here. Any living entity entering this domain suffers a rapid loss of frequency, eventually leading to the total dissolution of their existence.

A species of seal native to the Roya Frostlands, named for its snowball-like, round, white body. Docile in nature, Snowfluff Seals show little reaction to people or their surroundings, spending most of their time either eating or lying still. Only when facing extreme danger will they rear up and bare their fangs as a deterrent. If intimidation fails, they will promptly retreat to a safer area.

A special pharmaceutical substance developed for extremely rare diseases. However, its severe side effects make it intolerable for most, keeping it under ongoing research and validation. In its natural form, Ichor is a volatile golden liquid that radiates intense heat at room temperature. In rare cases, it can be controlled and stabilized into a solid form.
A pharmaceutical corporation based in the New Federation. Its core technology originates from the development of Ichor, a groundbreaking medical advancement shadowed by perpetual controversy.

Once a reputable poets society in Ragunna, consisting of three members: Faroll, Selena, and Rimbaud. They composed numerous anthems and poems glorifying the Sentinel and the Order, but were later accused of blasphemy by the Order and sent on a Pilgrim's Sail. They vanished thereafter without a trace, and mentioning of their names is now forbidden in Ragunna.

A large cake dedicated to the 1st anniversary of the launch of the Second Coming of Solaris Beta, as well as the control hub for its simulator. When asked about the hub's cake-shaped design, lead designer Encore replied, "What's a birthday without cake! Happy Anniversary!"
A virtual simulation game developed by the Pioneer Association. Despite many setbacks during development, thanks to Rover's trust and support, the game is steadily evolving towards its ideal form.

Officially known as "Remnant Cubes," these advanced artificial intelligences were created for the Second Coming of Solaris using Encore's abilities and Tethys's microprocessing support. Please note: Remnant Cubes are experimental simulations, automatically generated by the system. Their personalities and actions in the game do not reflect those of real individuals.

The Order's executive arm. Unlike Order Penitentiary, which trials the heretics and maintains faith, the Chamber of Discipline deals with secular cases, and enforces law and order, while also overseeing Ragunna's defenses against Tacet Discords. Its enforcers are often referred to as "Inquisitors."

Sonoro Sphere is a space of dense Remnant Energy capable of preserving transdimensional information. In Huanglong culture, such ethereal realms—neither tangible nor illusory—are often referred to as "mirages."
A signal transmission pathway. During its simulation, the Second Coming of Solaris briefly linked with the Tethys System, creating a temporary channel between them.
A mercenary group in the New Federation led by Calcharo.
An ancient epic poem of Rinascita. It pioneered blending various regional folkfore with the tales of the Sentinel, including the first accounts of the Carnevale's origins.
A shore where Rinascitan poets and musicians bury their retired instruments.

The autumn night's brightest constellation, shrouded in legends. A poet of Golden Anthem once wrote, "I am a night hawk of wings aflame, soaring towards the Celestial Steed, whose praises I sing and whose true form I behold." Such imagery always evokes Rinascita's Sentinel. But why soar towards it and behold its true form? Maybe the poem was intended to convey some message.

Music is composed of frequency, as is everything. Thus, everything hums its own melody. Ciaccona's Forte allows her to perceive these melodies; by retuning them, she crafts a Sonoro Sphere in her hands where stories and memories carried in music replay themselves. The deeper her understanding of the melodies, the richer the stories she can summon.
Deals Glacio DMG to enemies around the point of impact.
Deals Aero DMG to enemies along its trajectory.
Slices the enemies at close range to deal DMG. Cannot benefit from Attack Speed bonuses.
Pierces through enemies along its trajectory, dealing multiple instances of damage to enemies at intersections.
Greatly increase range and DMG Multiplier.

Deal Aero DMG to surrounding enemies equal to 100% of Rover's ATK. Then increase Movement Speed by 48%, which gradually decreases to 0% over 4s. Each 1% Movement Speed gained during this time grants 0.8% DMG Bonus.
<color=Highlight>At Resonator Lv. 5</color>
Movement Speed bonus increases to 64%, and the damage conversion rate rises to 1%.
<color=Highlight>At Resonator Lv. 10</color>
Movement Speed bonus increases to 80%, and the damage conversion rate rises to 1.2%.

Deal Fusion DMG to surrounding enemies equal to 100% of Galbrena's ATK. Then increase Attack Speed by 30% for 5s. Each damage dealt during this time increases the Weapon's Crit. Rate by 1% for 5s, stacking up to 20 times.
<color=Highlight>At Resonator Lv. 5</color>
Attack Speed bonus increases to 40%, and the Crit. Rate bonus now stacks up to 30 times.
<color=Highlight>At Resonator Lv. 10</color>
Attack Speed bonus increases to 50%, and the Crit. Rate bonus now stacks up to 40 times.

Deal Aero DMG to surrounding enemies equal to 40% of Iuno's Max HP. Then lose 30% of the current HP to increase ATK by 40% of her Max HP for 4s. Hitting an enemy during this time restores 1.5% of her Max HP.
<color=Highlight>At Resonator Lv. 5</color>
ATK conversion rate increases to 60%, and duration extends to 5s.

Threnodians are formidable creatures born from the Laments, with the power to destroy human spirit and feed off of their collapsed will. If civilizations represent mankind's collective will, the Threnodians embody our fears and struggles. They manifest as destructive Tacet Discord disasters spreading across the planet.

The term "Lament" refers to the ongoing catastrophic events on Solaris-3. Since the onset of the first Lament, the cycle of destruction has persisted relentlessly. The tide of devastation remains ceaseless, with no signs of stopping.
A form of pure energy with complete frequencies. The information it carries transcends time and space, enduring in a stable, unchanging state.
Transdimensional spaces where Remnant Energy is abundant are known as the Sonoro Spheres.

The "Tacet Fields" are thought to be where all Tacet Discords originate. These locations feature a sky of inverted seas and a deep cross-shaped Tacet Mark on the ground. Reverberations fill the air, linking our world to an unknown space through a white Resonance Cord. These areas attract gatherings of Tacet Discords.

SOL-3, the third planet from the sun. A world of chaos and change, where old conventions are discarded and disasters run rampant. Human civilization struggles to survive in this new era of destruction and rebirth, facing uncharted challenges with unwavering determination.

The Lament's power causes destructive waves across the land of Solaris. Manifestations like the "Tacet Fields," "Tacet Discord Outbreaks," and the enigmatic "Tacetite" are part of what is collectively known as the "Waveworn Phenomena."

Tacet Discords, beings created by the Waveworn Phenomena bearing "Tacet Cores", are dangerous entities with ever-changing, amorphous forms, which feed on other frequencies to maintain stability and evolution. These creatures mimic their prey's abilities, shapes, and behaviors, influenced by the types of frequency they consume.

A type of special frequency that can be captured by the Terminal to reproduce Tacet Discords' abilities.\nThere's a chance for Tacet Discords to leave behind "Reverberations" when they are eliminated, which can then be transformed into "Echoes" through the Terminal's Data Bank, providing a useful advantage in battle.

Wherever there is civilization and history, there will be Sentinels. They serve as mankind's guardians and conductors. Their immortal existence has helped humanity through countless troubles, sharing wisdom and prophecies. As humanity embarks on a new journey after enduring the Lament, the Sentinels remain as the record keeper and beacon in times of disaster.

And the Infrastructure Division, tasked with public works and construction projects.

Public Security Bureau staff who are responsible for the security issues of their jurisdictions.
The local law enforcement arm of the Justice Commission. Operating through Patrol Stations, it maintains civil order and handles public security matters. Its officers are known as "Patrollers."
The local enforcement unit of the Public Security Bureau that handles routine security operations and maintains public order.

Lollo Logistics is a trusted logistics company that delivers not only the tangible, but also the intangible.\nWhether it's sending sweet words to a loved one or retrieving lost memories, if it's ordered and can be delivered, Lollo Logistics will handle them with care.

Jinzhou, a fortified city on the frontier, stands guard against the looming Tacet Discord crisis. As one of Huanglong's six major regions, it bears the weight of this responsibility as the youngest provincial capital. The Midnight Rangers defend its northern border without hesitation.
The state-run research institute of Huanglong, with branch organizations established in each city.
Located at the edge of the continent, this country borders the sea to the east. It boasts a vast territory with one capital and six major cities.

The most enduring and enigmatic family in Ragunna, the Fisalias are renowned for their expertise in medicine and poison crafting. Their unwavering devotion to the Sentinel is well-known among the citizens.

Nestled on the edge of a cliff in Thessalleo Fells, Porto Veno Castle is a mysterious and magnificent residence of the Fisalias.\nAmong all the Fisalia family properties across Rinacista, this imposing cliffside castle stands out as the most special. It is the home of the current head of the Fisalia family.

A nation of independent city-states scattered across a vast archipelago, with no central administrative center. It is also known as the "Land of Echoes," which boasts unique natural and cultural landscapes.\nLegends speak of how Rinascita's founders fled their homelands and sailed to these islands to escape the Lament.

One of the city-states in Rinascita, Ragunna is a thriving port city on the edge of the sea, its districts linked by winding waterways.\nThe Ragunnesi are devout followers of the Sentinel, who believe Common Echoes to be gifts from the Sentinel that carry Their divine will.
A two-tiered holy edifice in Ragunna City, devoted to the worship of the Sentinel's statue.

The de facto ruling authority of Ragunna that manages all city matters, from municipal policies and currency to civil disputes.\nThe head of the Order, known as the Primus, is currently Fenrico, who claims to be the Enlightened One—the Resonator of Rinascita's Sentinel Imperator.\nAccording to city tradition, the Order's clergy serve as the Sentinel's earthly emissaries, guiding the people with Their divine word.
Religious people devoted themselves to the Order of the Deep.

One of the most powerful families in Ragunna, renowned for their pioneering spirit.\nThe Montelli family played an instrumental role in charting trade routes that not only connect Ragunna, but also greater Rinascita to the wider world. As the city opened its doors, the Montellis rose to prominence, amassing great wealth and unmatched influence.

The Carnevale is the grandest celebration of Ragunna, a time with never-ending masquerades, wine flowing like rivers, and music pulsing through the night.\nDuring this time, people cast aside the weight of the world and surrender to the wild, unrestrained joy of the festival.

At the peak of the Carnevale, the Sentinel is said to manifest and crown the finest performer with the "Laurel."\nThis honor grants the bearer the privilege to commune with the Sentinel and hear Their wisdom.

The universal currency issued by Huanglong, officially recognized across many regions.\nIn the ancient past, the ancestors of Huanglong utilized seashells as currency. Though the manufacturing techniques have evolved over time, the shell-like appearance of this currency has endured.
The Sentinel of Rinascita. Though worshipped as the Divinity by the Order of the Deep, Imperator rarely reveals Their presence to the public.
A colossal, whale-like Tacet Discord. Depite its gentle nature, its gargantuan size can inadvertently cause significant destruction.
A Montelli bank situated at the heart of the Ragunna City.

A troupe formed by exiles drifted to the Penitent's End on the Pilgrim's Sails for their supposed "transgressions."\nTo reveal the truth hidden by the Order, they wrote numerous plays and "danced in chains," performing tirelessly across the archipelago.

Solaris' foremost authority on observing the Lament cycle.\nThrough constant observation and analysis of Lament's shifting patterns, this organization predicts and warns of impending manifestations before they occur.

Also known as the Civilization Simulation Sand Table, the Tethys System is a supercomputer unique to the Black Shores. By inputting Lament frequency data—collected both manually and via beacon access—into the system, the Black Shores can issue Lament warnings for locations worldwide within a 24 to 48-hour time range. This capability is the cornerstone of the Black Shores' extensive collaborations with countries across the globe.

Modulation is the process of adjusting frequencies. In Solaris-3, frequencies serve as a crucial tool for uncovering the truth about reality. By altering these frequencies, one can delve into the very core of existence.\nAt the Black Shores, modulating Stellar Matrices is crucial for tracing and analyzing the Lament. Over the course of the Black Shores' history, only one individual has ever been honored with the title of "The Modulator"—Rover.
A globally popular competitive sport that puts both the strength and endurance of its participants to the test.
A unique martial art practiced by Yuanwu, known for its heavy and fierce strikes. However, only those who temper their strength with precise control can wield it without breaking themselves.
Danjin's favorite dessert. It is considered a symbol of good luck and blessings because of its association with loong.

One of the Sentinels of Huanglong, taking the shape of a Loong. The guiding force behind Jinzhou's civilization.\nA majestic "deity" with unquestionable power, omniscient of Jinzhou's past, present, and future. Jué, the wielder of time's flow, sees eons as mere moments. In an instant, Jué can change the universe forever.\n"Seasons shift by decree, and all beings abide by their laws. Such is the nature of the universe."

A grand construction located in the central axis of Jinzhou. Not only it reserves the functions of important reception and discussion of major issues, but also sets itself as the symbol of hope for the people of Huanglong.

The head governor of Jinzhou.\nIn Huanglong, when a Magistrate takes office, they adopt the region's name as their own. For example, Jinhsi was originally named Hsi but changed her name to Jinhsi after becoming the Magistrate of Jinzhou.

Cantarella's Resonance ability of poison manipulation. It induces vivid hallucinations in its targets, whether manifestations of their deepest desires or carefully crafted illusions.\nLike all Fisalia family's abilities, it comes at a price. Prolonged use risks trapping the wielder in their own dreams, blurring the line between reality and fantasy permanently.

A potion Cantarella developed in her girlhood through relentless experimentation.\nWhile mildly toxic itself, the brew counteracts most poison reactions and induces deep relaxation. It even offers partial protection against Threnodian whispers.\nHowever, those untrained in toxin tolerance may experience hallucinations.
The reality, as opposed to "this side of the dream."
The Other Side of the Dream
A strange being that resides within the Magic Box carried by Roccia. It appears to be born from the inspirations imbued in the collected objects inside the box.
A massive suitcase that never leaves Roccia's side, housing various stage props, play scripts, and Pero.
A dedicated protector of the Magistrate, also serving as their personal secretary.

Once a renowned Poets Society of Ragunna, its three members—Faroll, Selena, and Rimbaud—wrote many poems praising the Sentinel and the Order.\nHowever, they were banished by the Order for blaspheme against the Divinity. Sent aboard a Pilgrim's Sail, they vanished without a trace, and their names were forbidden in Ragunna.

Rebuilt by Changli during her time serving in Huanglong's capital, this charity organization is directly managed by the Central Court. It provides shelter to refugees and orphans displaced by plagues, famines, and TD Outbreaks.
Changli's mentor, a revered hermit in Huanglong known for his knowledge of statecraft and diplomacy. He traveled widely to share his wisdom and knowledge.
The advisor of Jinzhou's Magistrate. The current Counselor taught Jinhsi the way of governing before she became the Magistrate.

The origin of the games stems from the unwavering faith and determination of the people of Jinzhou to overcome the Lament. What started as a small-scale event to celebrate the victory against the Tacet Discords has now evolved into a military-civilian athletic gathering, aimed at promoting physical fitness and fostering camaraderie between soldiers and citizens to overcome any future challenges together.
A traveling performance group specializing in the traditional Liondance. They take commissions from both the Jinzhou Theater and private clients to support themselves and cover their travel expenses.

Liondance is combination of martial arts and choreography that has now become a signature folk art in Jinzhou. It originated from traditional boxing and martial arts in Huanglong, emphasizing swift footwork and powerful postures.
This traditional performance takes many forms, from solo shows featuring only the Agile Head to a duo combining both the Agile Head and the Steady Tail.\nAgile Head is a jargon for Lion Head.
This star-like flower represents love and courage. One day, these earthly stars will blanket every field.
A martial art embodying Taoist wisdom, where practitioners harmonize with nature's rhythms to develop balanced strength of body and mind.
The Averardo Bank run by the Montellis in the Ragunna City.

A popular name referring both to the abandoned underground waterway in Ragunna and the street gang that once operated there. Though the criminal organization was crushed by a mysterious vigilante years ago, rumors suggest they are creeping back from oblivion.

A catastrophe happened twenty years ago that not only destroyed the Avinoleum Theological Seminary but also wreaked havoc across Ragunna.\nFor the people of Ragunna, it was the sacrifice of Fleurdelys, the Blessed Maiden, who single-handedly halted the Second Dark Tide.

A decade ago, the Carnevale was attacked by a giant sea creature and plagued by TD outbreaks. Primus Fenrico intervened to end the chaos, but the event left new wounds for Ragunna City, which was still recovering from the Second Dark Tide.
The Midnight Rangers have three divisions: Outriders (reconnaissance), Vanguard (offensive operations), and Rearguard (defensive operations), all under the command of General Jiyan.
A Remnant Creature reminiscent of a white udumbara. It can communicate with Baizhi through telepathy.
A type of special Stellar Matrix used to contain the errors and discarded data of Tethys System.
A special expanse that collects all the dreams in Solaris since it came into being. It is managed by two Gatekeepers.
A special dimension dedicated to the mysterious film festival in the depths of Somnoire. Though isolated from the rest of Somnoire, it boasts the best equipment and environment for movie screenings.
An activity held in the depths of Somnoire. You've been invited to be a judge, but the identity of the host remains a complete mystery.
The Tacet Discords emerge from the frequencies of nightmares and negative emotions. They can often be found in Somnoire.
One of the administrators of Somnoire, tasked with deleting "useless data" within the realm, or so he says. However, he has his own opinions on what qualifies as "useless."
One of the administrators of Somnoire, tasked with keeping the realm running smoothly, or so he says.
A hidden, inaccessible space deep within Somnoire, where countless collected dreams lie buried.
The largest and most influential Gladiator event in Septimont, as well as a key economic pillar of the city.
A majestic name for the city of Septimont, perched atop Capitoline Hill. Its people are renowned as master sculptors, skilled hunters, and awe-inspiring gladiators who celebrate heroism.
An energy drink endorsed by Lupa.
Leaders of Septimont's temple who can foretell fate. They listen to the strings of destiny at a personal cost and offer guidance to those who seek answers.
A play script given by Phrolova. Every actor has their assigned role, and all stories unfold exactly as written, unless...

One of the six major cities in Huanglong, renowned for its abundant waterways, thriving greenery, and enchanting landscapes. Under the guidance of the local Sentinel, the Mengzhou people have developed unique Automata Mechanics.
The current Ephor reformed the Great Agon into a two-on-two competition. Now, gladiators must find a trusted partner to win the championship together.
A popular tavern situated in the commoner neighborhood, famous for its signature drink "Solis." Gladiators often spar there, with the loser footing the bill.
The ruler of Septimont. Ephors wield absolute power, as only the strong are deemed worthy to lead.
In the tales of Huanglong, mirrors are said to reveal hidden truths. And this one appears to show things unseen...
One of the signs that heralds the coming of a Dark Tide. It's when countless Tacet Discords swarm beneath the Blightcloud, descending upon Septimont in waves of destruction.

The final resting place of Septimont's heroes and legendary gladiators. Stone monuments, shaped after each fallen hero's signature weapon, stand tall in tribute to ensure their names and deeds endure through the ages.
Scars of the Dark Tide's touch. It may appear as discoloration, calcification, or even coral-like growths, depending on what has been corrupted.

A premier forge of high-end weaponry and gear, partnered with numerous noble houses. Its premium pricing, bespoke designs, and elite craftsmanship make it the top choice for aristocrats outfitting their champions.
A chain of mountains marking Septimont's edge, severely corrupted by the Dark Tide. Only the most daring Gladiators venture here seeking to train in its harsh conditions.
Participants in Gladiator matches. They are renowned for their strength and battle prowess and driven by an unyielding thirst for victory and glory.
Septimont's signature sport, where Echoes battle beside Gladiators. Victory in the arena hinges on their cooperation.
An Echo formed from the Reverberation of a fallen hero, fused into his armor. It longs to relive the thrill of glorious battle.
Septimont's central city—home to Gryphon's Fortress and the stage of the Great Agon.
The Lioness of Glory, Arsinosa. Born of battle cries and laughter, fused into the stone form of a mighty half-human, half-lion Echo. Since her genesis, she has stood watch over the City of Septimont.

The House Lupa fights for. One of Septimont's founding bloodlines, House Silva's roots once ran deep in the city's spire of influence. But with the rise of the new Ephor, such past glories have begun to wane.
The governing body of Septimont, tasked with advising the Ephor and wielding authority in key administrative matters. It also exercises power over the appointment and dismissal of public officials.
An omen of the coming Dark Tide, one that has lingered over Septimont for years. The region it shrouds is known to Septimontians as the "hunting grounds."
The port that connects Septimont to the outside world. Vessels laden with goods and fresh catch arrive by the hour, while visiting Gladiators and travelers make landfall here upon reaching Septimont.

The current Head Priestess of Septimont.

A scroll Lillibet carries, recording visions glimpsed in the flame light. Both this book and the murals within Tetragon Temple are media through which the Priestesses of Septimont convey prophecies to the people.
The legendary ruler of Septimont. The legend traces its roots to an ancient prophecy that only the one who becomes the Hero of Heroes can save Septimont from falling into ruin.
A secluded underwater experiment facility built by the Fractsidus and the Order, where they both pursue hidden ambitions under the guise of Common Echo reprocessing and production.

Phrolova's Sonoro Sphere, designed to replicate the Beyond through artificial means. Using the powers of Threnodian Leviathan, she intends to use bodies of Tacet Discords as hosts for the reverberating consciousness of the departed. In doing so, the Sonoro may merge with reality, and those long past can live in a new, eternal world free of decay.
A device for incubating Common Echoes. Twisted, shattered Echo frequencies are reconstructed into new Common Echoes within its chamber.

A Waveworn Phenomenon unique to Rinascita, the Dark Tide is a manifestation of the Threnodian Leviathan's power of Unity. Dark clouds amass overhead and crash down like a waterfall, surging in all directions. Wherever the Dark Tide spreads, it spawns Tacet Discords and scars the land with Tidal Blight. At its epicenter, a new Tacet Field forms.

High-density Remnant Energy from the Etheric Sea that projects past events with uncanny fidelity. The Retroact Rain unfolds in three distinct phases: natural descent, near-ground suspension, and reverse flow.

Humans selected by the Threnodian Leviathan to spread its doctrine, and sow sorrow and despair among the masses. Influence appears to be a key factor in their selection. Marked by the Dark Tide's corruption, they wield fragments of Leviathan's power, such as summoning its creations.
A world built upon thousands of Reverberations. A domain of decaying frequencies. A place where Phrolova found rebirth, which has now become a part of her existence.
Lingering power of the Threnodian Leviathan. After escaping from Mya's broken form, it concealed itself within the Ragunna gemstone on her helmet.

The Sanguis Plateaus was once the Septimont frontline against the Dark Tide. Due to the region's unique landscape, Remnant energy gathers here in unusual density, along with a Blightcloud perpetually looming overhead, formed since the first Dark Tide. During High Tide seasons, Gladiators from across Septimont arrive here to hunt Dark Tide creations in the name of glory.

A radio communication tower situated in the center of Honami City and the tallest building in the city. It was once Honami's most famous tourist attraction and landmark. It is said that the Lament that destroyed this city started from Neon Tower.

Citizens of Honami City who perished during the Lament and who now "live" inside the Sonoro Sphere in the form of Human Reverberations. Faint iridescent light flows around their bodies, and they don't seem to be aware of what really happened to them.

This pale rainbow-colored light surging in the Sonoro Sphere of Honami City is a Waveworn Phenomenon unique to this place. Traces of Irideglow's corruption can be found everywhere in Honami. During periodic Lament outbreaks, Irideglow condenses into a physical form that cuts through space, capturing and devouring everything it meets within the Sonoro. Resonators with long-term exposure to Irideglow have high risk of losing control of their Resonance power, and may even Overclock.

The unfulfilled, unresolved attachments of the Left Behind that are scattered throughout Honami City. They possess a special quality that can resonate with Neon Tower, helping their hosts locate the tower's location within the chaotic, overlapping spaces.

Traces of crystallization left on the surfaces of buildings and objects from Irideglow corruption. The mildly corrupted Irideglow Crystals—Light Irideglow Crystals, can be separated using certain methods.

Startorch Academy is a comprehensive research facility that doesn't belong to any country, built with the goal of collaborative scientific research. It is an academic metroplis driven solely by educational and research pursuits. Compared to its official title of "Startorch Academy," the people of Solaris prefer to call it the "Resonator Academy."
The regional Waveworn Phenomenon of Lahai-Roi that disrupts the frequencies of anything around it. It happens in a somewhat cyclical pattern.

An international scientific organization jointly established by various nations and organizations of Solaris. It oversees the research, development, and construction work in Lahai-Roi. It was the Spacetrek Collective that built the Research Institute and the Startorch Academy in the vast space beneath the frostlands.

This Remnant Creature living inside the Sonoro Sphere of Honami City was said to have been the city's mascot before its destruction. The original "Namipon" was initially conceived as a municipal transit mascot that safeguard citizens' daily commutes, moving at supersonic speeds between urban railroad tracks. Later on, it gradually evolved into a mascot encompassing various aspects of the city.

After Namipon's frequency was torn apart by the the Lament, individual creatures possessing fragments of its frequency were born in the form of various professions of Honami City citizens. Having temporarily lost connection with their original form, they now wander through various parts of the Sonoro Sphere of Honami.
The nation encompassing Honami City. Despite the frequent Waveworn Phenomena, it maintains a prosperous, highly urbanized society, marked by its sprawling railroad network.

Located deep beneath Lahai-Roi, guarded by the Roya for generations. Its unusually high Voidmatter levels make it off-limits to most.\nThe Spacetrek Collective has been permitted to conduct limited expeditions, but intense Voidmatter interference has so far yielded little meaningful intelligence.

An "anchor" left behind when the Exostrider first came to the lands that would one day be called Lahai-Roi.\nThe Spacetrek Collective mounted expeditions to its location, but returned with nothing worth recording.

The entry point formed when the Exostrider and the Threnodian Aleph-1 entered Solaris. The overlying Soliskin root network holds Aleph-1's power at bay, the "sealed doors" of the Stridergate.\nThe Keystone is the "lock" that keeps the Stridergate closed.\nBeyond it may lie the "universe" that Solaris has always longed to explore.

Ashinohara has long relied on the "miko system" to resist the Threnodian, with each miko organization assigned to a specific territory. The Miko of Flaming Sakura is unique, her responsibility spanning all of Ashinohara.
The Seal of Flaming Sakura is one of her line's secret arts, said to have been created by the very first Miko of Flaming Sakura . It is the only secret art passed down in written form. The seal draws power from the miko herself: the more power she channels into it, the longer it lasts.
The seal's form changes with its caster.
It is said that Hiyuki sealed away part of "her own future" within it—including, some say, a future that cannot be named.

This effect can be triggered once every 25s. Incoming Resonators receive healing from Suisui at the cost of <color=Highlight>Enrichment</color>.

After unlocking Inherent Skill - Sky Over Water, consuming <color=Highlight>Enrichment</color> grants the Resonator <SapTag=0>{0}</SapTag> {Cus:Sap,S=stack P=stacks SapTag=0} of <color=Highlight>Spring's Birth</color>, up to {1} stacks. When the Resonator with <color=Highlight>Spring's Birth</color> is on the field and not at full HP, restore their HP by {3} + {4} of Suisui's Max HP at the cost of 1 stack of <color=Highlight>Spring's Birth</color> every {2}s.

Upon casting <color=Highlight>Resonance Liberation - Song of Thoroughfare</color>, Suisui deploys <color=Highlight>Ceaseless Landscape</color> that lasts for 25s. During <color=Highlight>Ceaseless Landscape</color>, Suisui enters <color=Highlight>Heaven's Roam</color> when casting <color=Highlight>Outro Skill - Rippling Waters</color>.
<color=Highlight>Ceaseless Landscape</color> grants all nearby Resonators in the team the following enhancements:
- Inflicting a target with <color=Highlight><te href=850008>Spectro Frazzle</te></color>, <color=Highlight><te href=850011>Fusion Burst</te></color>, <color=Highlight><te href=850010>Glacio Chafe</te></color>, and <color=Highlight><te href=850009>Aero Erosion</te></color> increases the max stack limit of <color=Highlight><te href=850180>Negative Status</te></color> the target can receive by 3 for 15s.
- Inflicting a target with <color=Highlight><te href=850013>Electro Flare</te></color> increases the max stack limits of <color=Highlight><te href=850013>Electro Flare</te></color> and <color=Highlight><te href=150806>Electro Rage</te></color> the target can receive by 3 for 15s.
- Inflicting a target with <color=Highlight><te href=850012>Havoc Bane</te></color> allows the Resonator's Havoc DMG to ignore the target's DEF and Havoc RES by {0} and {1} respectively for 15s.

If there is <color=Highlight>Ceaseless Landscape</color> left on the field, Suisui enters <color=Highlight>Heaven's Roam</color> upon casting <color=Highlight>Outro Skill - Rippling Waters</color>. During this time, Suisui dances between <color=Highlight>Ceaseless Landscape</color>, and periodically applies certain effects to targets caught within <color=Highlight>Ceaseless Landscape</color>, based on the <color=Highlight>Floral Epistle</color> consumed from casting <color=Highlight>Outro Skill - Rippling Waters</color>.
